title: rathbunia pruinosa
intro: Rathbunia pruinosa, commonly known as Snow-on-the-mountain, is a flowering plant species native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rathbunia pruinosa include its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and promote better sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily responsible for its medicinal properties, including alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids.
